facts.value: Official high school transcripts are required if the applicant has fewer than 24 transferable semester hours of college credit after high school, is applying to a program that specifically requires a high school transcript, or has earned an associate degree (or higher) but with fewer than 24 transferable semester credits post-high school.
Transcripts must reflect all four years of coursework and include the graduation date.

Transcripts must be sent directly from the high school through a secure electronic service approved by ASU, by mail, or via email directly from a school official. ASU accepts hand-delivered official high school transcripts only if they are in a sealed envelope provided by the school. ASU does not accept faxed high school transcripts.

ASU requires a battery average score of 170 or higher for tests taken after 2013. ASU also accepts the HiSet, TASC, California High School Proficiency Examination, and College Credit Pathway, with some limitations.
ACT or SAT scores are not required for admission, but may be used in place of a high school GPA if necessary.
Scores must be sent directly to ASU from ACT or College Board. If AP, IB, or CLEP exams have been taken, request scores to be sent directly to ASU.
